name: Central Sector Scheme for Rehabilitation of Bonded Labourer
benefit:
> **For Adult Male Beneficiaries** - The rehabilitation assistance shall be ₹1,00,000/- per adult male beneficiary. - Beneficiaries have the option to deposit the assistance in an annuity scheme or receive it as a cash grant. - The District Administration will assess the cash requirement of the beneficiary and, with their consent, place the money in an annuity scheme.
> **Special Category
_eligibility_text: The beneficiary should be a rescued bonded labour.
